lesson.summary: A pipeline step that commits files matching the rigor fingerprint guarantees a stale marker every run
lesson.synthesized_rule: A rigor/freshness fingerprint must exclude artifacts the pipeline itself generates downstream of the review it fingerprints. Measured: ship Step 4c.iv git-adds .flow-lessons/*.json, the default source pattern includes a json clause, and staff-review Step 5a wrote the marker earlier in the same run -- so every lesson-harvesting ship ends in source-drift with a delta the review could not have seen. The prescribed auto-resolution is a full four-lens re-review, which trains people to click past the gate. Exclude pipeline output from the fingerprint, the same way dev-tracking docs already are and for the same stated reason.
